issues.title: [CRITICAL] Source and Catalog 300+ Kikuyu Proverbs with Cultural Analysis
issues.body:
```
## 🚨 CRITICAL TASK

### Task Description
Systematically collect Kikuyu proverbs from multiple sources and create structured catalog with cultural context annotations.

### Success Criteria
- [ ] 300+ unique Kikuyu proverbs sourced
- [ ] Initial English translations documented
- [ ] Cultural themes identified and categorized
- [ ] Usage contexts documented where available
- [ ] Source attribution for each proverb
- [ ] Data stored in structured format (CSV/Excel + database ready)

### Data Sources Strategy
- "1000 Kikuyu Proverbs" by Gikandi
- Academic papers and theses
- Cultural organization websites
- Community elder interviews (post-ethics approval)
- Existing digital collections

### Quality Assurance
- Cross-reference proverbs across sources
- Note variations in wording or translation
- Document source reliability and date

### Due Date: July 1, 2025
### Estimated Effort: 16 hours
```
